verdict.rationale: OpenCode explicitly ships a 'read-only agent for exploring codebases' and a 'plan agent' for analyzing code and reviewing suggestions without making changes, and community feedback praises its LSP integration for navigating code. This supports codebase comprehension but there's no dedicated documentation of deeper architecture-mapping, dependency visualization, or codebase-summary features beyond these agent modes. Missing for 10: explicit docs on architecture/dependency mapping, structured codebase summarization output, and independent hands-on validation of the explore/plan agents specifically for onboarding to unfamiliar codebases.
